hypothesis: Phase-12 failed because three decoded/quantized frames provide too few independent transitions to estimate a slow unseen dispersive law when transition quantization error exceeds the one-step physical signal. Using eight context frames while freezing the representation, feature basis, ridge and NLS family will provide enough averaging for robust context-only identification.

frozen_representation.state_codec: 2048+128 residual VQ fit on the exact Phase-10/11 wave+Gray training mixture

frozen_identifier.target: absolute next decoded physical state, identical functional form to Phase 12
frozen_identifier.features: unchanged 16-feature Phase-7/10/11/12 generic local spatial+cubic basis
frozen_identifier.feature_scaling: per-sequence RMS over all seven observed transitions; constant scale fixed to 1

unseen_family.name: same Phase-12 2-D cubic nonlinear Schrodinger / Gross-Pitaevskii-like synthetic PDE

evaluations.baseline: raw-state persistence from final raw context frame
evaluations.metric: companded projected rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE

execution_rule: Each registered replicate executes exactly once and is persisted before the next. No retry, replacement seed, context change, ridge change, feature change, tokenizer refit on NLS, compander change, or threshold change after any registered attempt is consumed.

pass_rule.required: PASS only if the frozen companded arm has ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all four NLS tests in all three fresh replicates (12/12 cells).
pass_rule.failure_policy: Any registered ratio >= 1.0 makes Phase 13 FAIL; remaining registered replicates still run once for characterization if infrastructure permits.

pre_execution_validation: fit uses exactly 8 decoded context frames and all 7 transitions
no NLS trajectory enters normalization, state-codebook or innovation-codebook fitting
all registered seeds unique within Phase 13
only non-registered smoke seeds used before registered execution
claim_limit: A PASS would show that additional observed transitions rescue this fixed representation+identifier on this one unseen synthetic NLS family. It would not establish a universal scientific tokenizer, unrestricted law discovery, novel physics, AGI, or SSI.
